description: Step 5: Try it in text. Try the receptionist in text mode (no number needed; billed like a call at the AI rate from the wallet, the free trial credit covers it). First call: omit callId and pass callerText "" to get the greeting; then pass the returned callId with each caller line. Reuse an idempotencyKey when retrying; without one, each call executes again.

businessId.description: Defaults to the business of the API key in the Authorization header.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional. Retries of the same call should reuse it (the stored result comes back); a new value deliberately repeats an identical call. The MCP POST's Idempotency-Key header takes precedence.
